name: ott-speed-playback
description: Finish videos in the time you have with adaptive playback speed and local personal pace memory.

scripts.check: node --check content.js && node --check background.js && node --check options.js
scripts.zip: powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path background.js, content.js, manifest.json, styles.css, options.html, options.css, options.js, icon16.png, icon48.png, icon128.png -DestinationPath ott-speed-playback-v3.0.zip -Force"
